subject.title: [Feature]: Auto‑forward images from Node agent.request to IM users when deliver: true

question: Should `agent.request` gain an explicit opt-in media relay path that forwards Node-originated attachments to channel recipients when the agent reply has no media?
rationale: This is not a broken existing contract; it changes who may cause credentialed channel media delivery and how agent-authored output controls visibility.

options.title: Approve explicit opt-in relay
options.body: Add a protocol field only with target authorization, channel capability checks, size/type limits, audit, and agent override/suppression semantics.

options.title: Keep agent-controlled delivery
options.body: Do not add fallback media forwarding; document direct `send` and message-tool media delivery as the supported dumb-relay paths.

options.title: Defer to plugin/channel design
options.body: Keep this issue open only for a broader channel or plugin API discussion if current direct-send surfaces are insufficient.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit opt-in relay
recommendation.body: Add a protocol field only with target authorization, channel capability checks, size/type limits, audit, and agent override/suppression semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily product/security boundary direction across Gateway, Agents, and channel delivery, and CONTRIBUTING lists Peter as the project lead.
